page: Microsoft Azure FX96-48ms_v2 is a memory-intensive virtual machine from the FXmsv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor with a base clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The configuration provides 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor features a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache, supporting advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated mathematical and AI workloads.

This server is equipped with 1832.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory density of 38.17 GB per core. It does not include local storage, though it is premium storage capable for external disk attachments. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The hardware profile lacks dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on the high-frequency Intel Xeon CPU for processing.

In benchmark testing, the FX96-48ms_v2 demonstrates strong memory and compute capabilities. It achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 2341.0 and a multi-core score of 20535.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 4135.8 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 332.13 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Database performance is notable, with Redis SET operations reaching 74.96 million operations per second. This profile is highly suited for memory-intensive enterprise databases, large-scale in-memory analytics, and high-performance computing workloads requiring fast single-core execution and massive RAM capacity.
